versions.short: The resolution designates July 30, 2026, as National Whistleblower Appreciation Day and encourages each federal executive agency to recognize it. Agencies are asked to inform employees, contractors working for the public, and members of the public about the legal right of a United States citizen to report misconduct, fraud, misdemeanors, or other crimes to the appropriate authority in honest and good faith. Agencies are also asked to acknowledge how whistleblowers help combat waste, fraud, abuse, and violations of federal laws and regulations.
